sam_sales: Quick sync — Skyline Health POC. They want a 3-week pilot to validate clinical note summarization + semantic search. Need alignment on success criteria (quality/evals), integration plan (SDK, auth, streaming), and any quota/pricing constraints. Who can drive the tech plan?

eli_engineer: I can own the integration runbook. A couple of clarifying q's: 1) Will summaries be rendered live via streaming in the app? 2) Do they need embed indexing in our hosted vector store or do they run their own?

maria_pm: Product asks: success criteria = (a) avg summary ROUGE-like score > baseline on our eval set, (b) end-to-end latency < 800ms p95 for interactive flows, (c) semantic search retrieval precision >= 0.78 on pilot queries. These are negotiable but a starting point.

josh_solutions: From presales: Skyline will try 5 clinicians during pilot, ~500 daily note uploads, bursts at 50/s while processing. They asked about SKUs and any trial credits. We can offer 1 month of reduced pricing for the POC — need pricing and quota guardrails.

anya_security: Heads-up on the security questionnaire: they want cert copies (SOC2 Type II), encryption at rest + in transit, and guidance on data residency. We can share our standard SOC2 pack; for POC we need to confirm whether PHI will be in scope — if yes, escalate for BAAs. @sam_sales please confirm.

sam_sales: They will include PHI in a restricted pilot dataset but want to pseudonymize before sending. They asked if we support customer-managed keys (KMS) in Private deployments.

eli_engineer: Technical notes: for hosted POC we support KMS-backed encryption only on Private, but we can setup strict separation via Dedicated. For the SDK, auth is API key for hosted; for Private we support token exchange + OIDC. Example quickstart (Python):

```
# python example (hosted)
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
resp = client.generate(model="rw-clinical-7b", streaming=True, max_tokens=256)
for chunk in resp.stream():
    print(chunk.text, end='')
```

eli_engineer: For retries, recommended client-side policy: exponential backoff up to 3 retries for 5xx and 429 with jitter. Server-side we can configure quota + burst policy. Example curl header for quota awareness: `X-Request-ID` and check `Retry-After` header.

josh_solutions: On quotas/pricing: propose we set a soft quota of 100k tokens/day for pilot with alerting; provide a measured invoice at pilot end. Is there any uplift for streaming tokens vs non-streaming?

eli_engineer: Streaming doesn't change token billing but may affect concurrency/backpressure. We should cap concurrent streams per org to 20 for POC to avoid neural queue buildup. Infra-bot can do a temporary route to a Dedicated pool if we see overload.

infra-bot: NOTE: temporary Dedicated pool can be provisioned for POC; provisioning lead time ~48 hours and needs a 2-week commit window. Contact eng-infra to request.

anya_security: For the questionnaire we can supply: SOC2 bundle, data processing addendum template, encryption at rest/in transit details, and recommended pseudonymization checklist. If PHI remains, we need legal to sign a BAA before customer data ingests.

maria_pm: Next: action items and owners — eli to produce a 1-page tech runbook (SDK snips, auth flows, streaming sample, retry config) by EOD tomorrow. anya to prepare the security pack + BAA checklist by Friday. josh to confirm pilot user list and expected query patterns. sam to confirm whether pseudonymized data will be used or if raw PHI needs BAA.

sam_sales: Perfect. Also confirm: can we offer an initial $5k pilot credit (applied to usage) to remove friction? Finance ok'd up to that amount for deals under review.

josh_solutions: That helps. I'll confirm with Skyline and push for the pseudonymized dataset first.

eli_engineer: I'll draft the runbook and include sample SDK snippets for Node + Python, plus a short checklist for embedding refresh cadence and semantic index sizing.

maria_pm: I'll prepare the evaluation harness (prompt set + expected outputs) so Skyline can run blind evals and we can run automatic regression checks.

sam_sales: Thanks all — sync-up scheduled tomorrow 10am PT. If anything blocks earlier, ping this thread. :thumbsup:
